title: Secrets
summary: Foxwillow's secrets (R13): what the party has learned of each villager, the tender secrets carried into the corn, and what was paid at the gate.
empty: No secrets learned yet. Foxwillow keeps them close, and the corn wants them.

entries.title: William
entries.text: He had an affair with Martha, and Isaac is his son.

entries.title: Martha
entries.text: She killed Malachai, in self-defence, and she knows about the affair.

entries.title: Jonah
entries.text: He cast the hex that withers the fields and herds, not the scarecrows.

entries.title: Isaac
entries.text: He skimmed his mother's money from the inn.

entries.title: Adelaide
entries.text: She murdered Isaac and hid him in the mill cellar.

entries.title: Jericho's banjo
entries.text: Found in the store's rubble. A hero carries it into the corn.

entries.title: The song sheet
entries.text: Jericho's song, written out. A hero carries it into the corn.

entries.title: Jericho's certificate
entries.text: The town hall's record that Jericho belonged here. A hero carries it into the corn.

entries.title: Raum's price
entries.text: Secrets paid to Raum: {flag.secrets_paid}. Each one made him stronger.
A hero paid with a secret of their own.
